And you know what? It's certainly not going to be a bloody PDRN serum treating any of these "issues" 🥲 Sometimes I get tagged in skin concern videos, and I just think: if you genetically have more pronounced nasolabial folds at 21, that is just going to be a part of your face. We all have things we like and dislike about our faces, but fundamentally, our face has to move, and therefore there will be creases. This is also why it looks odd when celebrities get incredibly taut facelifts, because a face without any creases looks a bit uncanny valley.  So whilst I know lots of people are going to be telling me you can get filler in your nasolabial folds and that helps a little bit, I honestly feel like you won't be able to fully escape the nasolabial folds (as skin just continues to drop and sag as we age). And then you're most likely going to end up with filler migration or looking puffy because, when you got it, it only really did what you needed it to do for like 6 months or so. Then you're stuck on the hamster wheel of always chasing perfection.  I just think if you really want to treat parts of your face, you might as well treat the things that we have very developed and efficient treatments for, like forehead lines and Botox. But the three skin concerns I've mentioned in this video, I feel like we should collectively agree to just ignore forever.  #skincare #agingskin #pdrn #aesthetics
